subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 4 – Lesson 8: Skills – Listening, Speaking and Writing (a report)
outcomes: Listen and find information about Hamzah the farmer.
Ask: What do you want to be when you grow up? Why?
Write a report in paragraphs using 'because'.

tf.why: Yes! Hamzah works on a farm.

tf.s: Hamzah is working on his uncle's farm.
tf.why: Correct! He works on his uncle's farm.
Well done! He thinks it's healthy.
He grows other vegetables and sometimes has sheep, too.

tf.s: We use 'because' to give a reason.
'He want to be a mechanic' is correct.
tf.why: With he, we say wants: He wants to be a mechanic.

tf.s: In Talal's report, a new idea starts a new paragraph.
tf.why: Correct! Each idea gets its own paragraph.

tf.s: Talal wants to be a chef.
tf.why: Talal wants to be a video game animator.

tf.s: The last paragraph of the report is about the writer's own opinion.
tf.why: Yes! It says what Talal wants to be.
